Work and interests

01 / My work

Career development

  • From molecular biology to bioinformatics

    It started with molecular neurobiology using the model organism C.elegans looking for novel neurotransmitter transporter proteins. Working with this organism I developed an interest in developmental biology and went on to study the formation of teeth, I continued the theme of developmental biology looking at early heart development. It was during my next role I discovered bioinformatics, my supervisor handed me a external hard disk drive with exome sequencing data and asked me to deal with it. I spent the next few months converting my desktop PC to linux, learning the command line and the myriad tools required to align sequence data, call variants and annotate them.

  • Examples

    During my career as a bioinformatician my guiding principal is understanding the science and having the flexibility to attempt new methods and present data in clear and interesting ways One example of this is my collaboration with Emanuele Azzoni and Marella de Bruijn in this paper: onset of circulation triggers a metabolic switch required for endothelial to hematopoietic transitionI presented processed the single-cell transcriptomic data and presented it in a useable format
